reason: I already tried a budget app and quit after a few weeks because I stopped entering things. This sounds better because the slips are scanned for me, but I still have to remember to take the photos every day, and I know I won't.
objection: I'll forget to scan the slips every day, and then the whole thing goes stale like the last app did.
would_change_my_mind: If it reminded me or picked up my slips automatically without me having to do anything each day.
